blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Classifying warehouse as Group F (industrial) instead of Group G (storage) — ERR-DSGN-003","Using 1 person per 9.3 sqm (office) instead of 1 person per 46.5 sqm (warehouse/storage)","Specifying loading dock door as 3.0m × 4.0m instead of 3.6m × 4.5m","Calculating parking at 1 per 100 sqm instead of 1 per 1,000 sqm (minimum for Group G)","Assuming clear height of 5.0m is acceptable instead of 6.0m minimum standard","Confusing loading dock height with building entrance height (dock = 1,200mm, not 900mm)","Omitting separate HVAC zones for cold chain temperature ranges (−25°C to +10°C)","Using 4.0m × 4.0m door for semi-trailer access (correct = 3.6m × 4.5m)","Assuming high-bay design at 9.0m is always more cost-effective than standard 6.0m","Overlooking vapor barrier requirements in cold storage insulation, causing condensation and structural damage"]} />
